Court of Darkness: Adoration’s Kiss is Now Available on Nintendo Switch!

Published on August 26, 2026 by Chlo
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:26
Instaread


Voltage Inc. has announced that Court of Darkness: Adoration’s Kiss will launch for the Nintendo Switch on Thursday, August 27, 2026. The upcoming title marks the third Nintendo Switch release based on Voltage’s popular ongoing otome app, Court of Darkness.

ABOUT THE GAME

Originally launched in Japan in 2018, Court of Darkness celebrated its eighth anniversary in February 2026. This sophisticated isekai fantasy for adult audiences features intricately woven storylines, captivating characters, and beautifully detailed illustrations. The story follows a heroine who is transported to a magical world, where she becomes entangled with a group of princes who crave the power held within her kiss and will stop at nothing to claim it, tempting her with sweet words and irresistible advances.

Following the second Court of Darkness Nintendo Switch release earlier this year, Adoration’s Kiss introduces another new cast of consorts for players to romance. As with the previous Switch releases, the game adapts stories from the original mobile app while presenting them in a new format. The Nintendo Switch™ version also trades the app’s vertical format for a horizontal layout, offering a fresh way to experience each story.

STORY

The night of a crimson crescent moon, you find yourself transported to a realm called Saligia.

Far removed from your everyday life, you’re in a world where magic is commonplace.

In the midst of your confusion,before you appear five beautiful princes.

They crave the power your kiss can bestow, and will scheme to get it.

But what they seek is not just your power.
They want your heart as well…

CHARACTERS

Advertisement

KEY FEATURES

  • Horizontal layout optimized for Nintendo Switch™, offering a fresh viewing experience
  • Ability to play on TV via docked mode for a larger, more immersive screen
  • Rich, intricately woven isekai fantasy storyline
  • Cast of captivating princes, each with unique routes and personalities
  • Beautiful, high-quality illustrations and character designs

CONTENTS

The Nintendo Switch version includes the following stories from the romance app Court of Darkness. The Princes’ Path includes the Book 1 Prologue through Book 3, excluding Special Tales. Meanwhile, the Consorts’ Paths include Book 1 for Jasper Lane, Tino Maes, Knight, and Grayson Hotz. ***Please note that this version does not include voice or avatar features.

For more information about this announcement and Voltage Inc.’s otome titles, including details on their upcoming games and Nintendo Switch-mobile port lineups, check out their official website here.
